fieldValues.title: srs-mcp cannot depend on srs-cli, so the service structs are the wire contract
fieldValues.summary: The MCP crate sits beside srs-cli, not above it, so it cannot reuse the CLI's payload structs. The consequence is structural: srs-repository's own service result types carry Serialize and are served verbatim, which makes them the contract two adapters now depend on rather than an internal shape.
evidence: TreeResult and TreeNode gained Serialize (camelCase) in srs-repository and are served verbatim by the MCP resource
AgentIndex was already Serialize and needed no change
No new payload struct in srs-cli, so no golden schema regeneration was required (the container payload is Value-typed)
The CLI's ASCII 'text' field on the tree result is presentation and is deliberately not carried over MCP
fieldValues.body: This is the capability-layering rule showing its teeth in a good way: the core owns the shape, and each adapter adds only presentation. It also raises the cost of changing a service result type — two adapters now observe it — which is the correct price for having one home for the semantics. The split it forces is visible in the tree resource: the recursion is shared, the ASCII rendering stays behind in the CLI.
